query: What does CAP stand for in the Maharashtra Unaided Private Professional Educational Institutions Act?
expected_answer: CAP stands for Centralized Admission Process, the centralized admission process carried out by the competent authority through a single-window system for admissions to professional courses.

query: Who is the Competent Authority under the Maharashtra Unaided Private Professional Educational Institutions (Regulation of Admissions and Fees) Act, 2015?
expected_answer: The Competent Authority is the Commissioner of State CET appointed by the Government to conduct CET through the Centralized Admission Process for admissions into private professional educational institutions.

query: Name three national initiatives that universities are instructed to inform students about under School Connect 2.0.
expected_answer: The circular includes initiatives such as Apprenticeship Embedded Degree Programme (AEDP), SWAYAM, Vidyalaxmi Loan Scheme, SATHEE, Internship, IKS, Mahaswayam and PM-USP.

query: What is the purpose of the revised credit framework Government Resolution issued on 16 May 2023?
expected_answer: The Government Resolution issues revised guidelines for the curriculum and credit framework relating to exit options, one-year postgraduate programmes and two-year postgraduate programmes for implementation from the academic year 2023-24.

query: According to the Government Resolution dated 30 June 2023, why were government approvals issued to unaided professional institutions for the academic year 2023-24?
expected_answer: Government approval was granted because the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) had granted approvals and the Director of Technical Education had recommended the proposals for the academic year 2023-24.

query: I'm planning to start a new engineering college and need to know about the government approval process after AICTE grants approval. Which uploaded document should I look at first?
expected_answer: The most relevant document is the Government Resolution dated 30 June 2023 regarding approvals for unaided professional institutions. It covers government approval for new institutions and related proposals based on AICTE approvals.

query: Which document discusses the regulation of admissions through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP), and which document discusses government approval of institutions after AICTE approval?
expected_answer: The Maharashtra Unaided Private Professional Educational Institutions (Regulation of Admissions and Fees) Act, 2015 defines and regulates the Centralized Admission Process (CAP), while the Government Resolution dated 30 June 2023 deals with granting government approval to institutions following AICTE approval.

query: Which uploaded document should I refer to if I want to know how the Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education is constituted?
expected_answer: Refer to the Maharashtra State Board of Technical Education Act, 1997, particularly the chapter dealing with the establishment and constitution of the Board.
